title_en: The Girl Lay Down and Fell Asleep
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'луди' (mad ones / lads) and 'низ него да се провира' (read as slipping a finger through the ring) are my reading.

lines.en: The girl lay down, fell asleep, alas,
on Ibro's knee.
Ibro was waking the girl, alas,
kissing her white face.

lines.cyr: - Стани си моме, не спи си леле,
lines.lat: - Stani si mome, ne spi si lele,
lines.en: - Get up, girl, do not sleep, alas,
the sheep have gone to the shearing.
Though the sheep went to the shearing, alas,
they went and they came back.

lines.cyr: - Не можам лудо да станам, леле,
lines.lat: - Ne možam ludo da stanam, lele,
lines.en: - I cannot get up, silly one, alas,

lines.cyr: на сон ми дошле три луди.
lines.lat: na son mi došle tri ludi.
lines.en: three mad ones came to me in a dream.

lines.cyr: На сон ми дошле три луди, леле,
lines.lat: Na son mi došle tri ludi, lele,
lines.en: Three mad ones came to me in a dream, alas,
three mad young lads.
The first gave me an apple, alas,
the second gave me a gold ring.

lines.cyr: Други ми даде злат прстен, леле,
lines.lat: Drugi mi dade zlat prsten, lele,
lines.en: The second gave me a gold ring, alas,
the third kisses me.

lines.cyr: Тој што ми даде јаболко, леле,
lines.lat: Toj što mi dade jabolko, lele,
lines.en: The one who gave me an apple, alas,
may he stay green for ever.

lines.cyr: Тој што ми даде злат прстен, леле,
lines.lat: Toj što mi dade zlat prsten, lele,
lines.en: The one who gave me a gold ring, alas,
may I slip through it.

lines.cyr: Тој што ме мене целува, леле,
lines.lat: Toj što me mene celuva, lele,
lines.en: The one who kisses me, alas,
may I live my life with him!
